steps.title: Sample Preparation and Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract intracellular metabolites from Arabidopsis thaliana tissues using a bead-beating process.

substeps.instruction: Weigh approximately 25 mg of freeze-dried Arabidopsis thaliana tissues into bead beating tubes and record exact weights; keep samples frozen.
Add approximately 200 μl of 0.5 mm silica glass beads to each sample.
Prechill the bead beater (OMNI Bead Ruptor Elite NE486LUA) to -1 °C with ethanol and dry ice.
Add 500 μl MQ water with 500 nM AZT and vortex mix.
Extract tissue samples in the bead beater using these settings: Speed 7.00 m/s, 3 x 45 sec pulses, with 30 sec intervals between pulses.
Add 0.4 ml chloroform to the samples, vortex mix, and sonicate in an ice bath for 10 min.
Aliquot 500 μl of samples for GC-MS open profiling.
Add 1 ml methanol to the ground samples and vortex mix.
Evaporate methanol using a vacuum concentrator until approximately 400 μl of liquid (water fraction) remains.
Centrifuge at 16,000 RCF for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer approximately 1 ml of the aqueous layer to new 2 ml Eppendorf tubes, avoiding the protein interface layer.
Let stand for 10 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge at 16,000 RCF at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Transfer 200 μl into HPLC glass vial inserts. Samples may be used immediately or stored at -80 °C.

steps.title: HPLC Amino Acid Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform amino acid analysis using UHPLC with OPA and FMOC derivatisation.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL of crude sample solution to 25 µL of 1 mM internal standards.
Load FMOC reagent, OPA reagent, Borate buffer, Iodoacetic acid, and Mobile phase A into HPLC vials in the autosampler.
Add 1.5 µL of OPA reagent to derivatise primary amino acids; mix and incubate for 20s at 4 °C.
Add 1 µL of FMOC reagent to derivatise secondary amino acids; mix and incubate for 20 s at 4 °C.
Lower the pH by adding 50 µL of Mobile phase A (pH 7).
Inject the total volume (57.5 µL) into the UHPLC.
Set UHPLC parameters: Column Temperature 37 ºC, Flow rate 1.8 mL/min.
Monitor OPA-derivatised amino acids at 340 ex/450 em nm (1-18 min) and FMOC-derivatised amino acids at 260 ex/325 em nm (18-21 min).
Quantify using standard curves (range 1.95 to 1000 µM) and integrate chromatograms using Chromeleon software.

steps.title: LC-MS/MS Central Carbon Metabolism Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze central carbohydrate metabolic network (CCM) metabolites using LC-MS/MS.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 500 µM 13C sorbitol to the 500 µL samples prepared during extraction and vortex.
Set Shimadzu 8060 LC-MS/MS with Phenomenex Gemini NX-C18 column (3µm x 150mm x 2mm) and SecurityGuard column (4 x 2.0mm ID).
Configure MS/MS settings: negative ionisation mode, Nebulizing Gas 3 L/min, Heating gas 10 L/min, Drying gas 10 L/min, Interface temperature 300 °C, Desolvation line temperature 250 °C.
Set injection volume to 5 µL and flow rate to 0.3 mL/min.
Use Mobile Phase A (7.5 mM Tributylamine adjusted with acetic acid to pH 4.95) and Mobile Phase B (100% acetonitrile).

Apply chromatographic gradient: 0-8 min (2% B); 8-22 min (2% to 20% B); 22-32 min (to 27% B); 32-47 min (to 50% B); 47-48 min (sharp rise to 98% B); 48-54 min (hold 98% B); 54-60 min (reduce to 2% B).
Set oven temperature to 45 °C.

steps.title: GC-MS Open Profiling
steps.instruction: Perform open profiling for amino acids, organic acids, sugars, and fatty acids via GC-MS.

substeps.instruction: Dry 10 µL aliquots of the extract in a glass insert using a speed vacuum.
Perform a final dry down by adding 25 µL methanol to ensure samples are completely dry.
Add 25 µL methoxyamine (meox) solution (30 mg/ml in pyridine) and incubate at 37 °C for 2 hours, then centrifuge for 10 seconds.
Add 25 µL BSTFA + 1% TMCS reagent and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Leave at room temperature for 2 hours before injection.
Inject 1 µL of sample into a Shimadzu GC/MS-TQ8050 NX system (inlet 280 °C, split mode 1:10).
Use an Agilent DB-5 ms capillary column (30 m × 0.25 mm × 1 µm) with Helium carrier gas at 1 mL/min.
Set oven conditions: 100 °C for 4 min, ramp 10 °C/min to 320 °C, hold for 11 min.
Fragment compounds using electron impact (EI) ionization; analyze in full scan and MRM mode using the Shimadzu Smart Metabolites Database.
Curate the matrix using Shimadzu LabSolutions Insight GCMS (v.3.7 SP3), removing targets not present in all samples.

steps.title: Sample Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute samples as needed for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute in 200 μl of 2% acetonitrile solution (5x concentrated).
